s1.syndrome_frame: Syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with systemic features
key_facts: Bilateral cataract extraction with 13D monofocal intraocular lenses 3 years earlier
Transient neutropenia in childhood that resolved spontaneously
Joint hyperextensibility of the hands, feet, ankles, and knees
Best-corrected visual acuity was 2/10 in each eye
Fundus examination showed bilateral disc pallor, generalized arteriolar narrowing, mid-peripheral bone-spicule pigmentary changes, and retinal pigment epithelium atrophy

shortlist.label: Bardet-Biedl syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with systemic features, including intellectual disability, obesity, and joint hyperextensibility

shortlist.label: Cohen syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmentary retinal dystrophy, intellectual disability, and microcephaly, with possible myopia and cataracts

shortlist.label: Alstrom syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Syndromic pigmentary retinal dystrophy with obesity, intellectual disability, and possible myopia

shortlist.label: Usher syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmentary retinal dystrophy with nyctalopia and possible hearing loss, although not mentioned in the case

shortlist.label: Senior-Loken syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Pigmentary retinal dystrophy with possible intellectual disability and systemic features

raw.rationale: The combination of high bilateral myopia, nyctalopia, intellectual disability, microcephaly, truncal obesity, and joint hyperextensibility, along with the specific retinal dystrophy characteristics, aligns closely with Cohen syndrome, which is known for its association with these features.

rejected.label: Bardet-Biedl syndrome
rejected.why: While Bardet-Biedl syndrome shares some features like intellectual disability and retinal dystrophy, the absence of polydactyly and the specific combination of other symptoms in the vignette make it less likely.

rejected.label: Alstrom syndrome
rejected.why: Alstrom syndrome typically presents with a more pronounced hearing loss and a different set of systemic features that do not fully align with the case description.

rejected.label: Usher syndrome
rejected.why: Usher syndrome is primarily characterized by the combination of retinitis pigmentosa and congenital deafness, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Senior-Loken syndrome
rejected.why: Senior-Loken syndrome is characterized by retinal dystrophy and nephronophthisis, a renal condition not mentioned in the case, making it an unlikely diagnosis.
